description: This file defines the RooProtectedController class which manages write protection for Roo configuration files by matching file paths against predefined patterns using the ignore library. It provides methods to check if files are protected, retrieve protected files from a list, annotate paths with protection status, and generate instructions and messages related to protected files.

classes.name: RooProtectedController
classes.description: A class that enforces write protection on Roo configuration files based on predefined patterns, providing methods to check protection status, retrieve protected files, and generate related instructions.

methods.name: isWriteProtected
methods.description: Checks if a given file path is write-protected based on the ignore patterns.

methods.name: getProtectedFiles
methods.description: Returns a set of protected files from a list of file paths.

methods.name: annotatePathsWithProtection
methods.description: Returns an array of objects indicating whether each path is protected.

methods.name: getProtectionMessage
methods.description: Provides a message indicating that the file requires approval for modifications.

methods.name: getInstructions
methods.description: Generates formatted instructions about protected files for use in LLM or documentation.

methods.name: getProtectedPatterns
methods.description: Returns the list of protected patterns used by the class.
